headline: Jets place Dylan DeMelo on injured reserve
take:
Three teams are down a defenseman, per Daily Faceoff. The Jets put Dylan DeMelo on injured reserve after what looked like a leg injury against Dallas, the Stars will be without Lian Bichsel for at least two weeks from the same game, and the Devils placed Johnathan Kovacevic on IR and recalled Anton Silaev.

DeMelo is the one that hurts most. He plays 19 minutes a night for a Winnipeg team that is 9-8-3 and below even on chance quality (48% of the expected goals), and the Jets lose a regular on the penalty kill as well. Bichsel has been a physical third-pair presence for Dallas, with 39 hits in 18 games, but the Stars have done better without him at 5-on-5. New Jersey, 14-6-0 with 58% of the expected goals, the best share among these three, can absorb Kovacevic's 15 minutes more easily than most. Silaev, a 2024 first-round pick, gets a look.
